headline: Wissa will start
body: Chronicle Live (Lee Ryder), 31 Oct 2026 07:00: Between now and Monday, Newcastle will assess Osula's ankle. Jaissle would have to consider playing Yoane Wissa as the lone striker on Monday if Osula and Fernandez-Pardo don't make it. Hall started the cup rematch build-up at LB in the Dedic–Schär–Burn–Hall back four.
